paragraphs: WeRide develops autonomous driving technology ranging from driver assistance up to fully driverless Level 4 systems. Its footprint now spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries.

The portfolio holds five products: robotaxis, robobuses, robovans, robosweepers and a driver-assistance system. Between them they cover passenger mobility, logistics and street sanitation. The robobus is offered for public operations including day transport, bus rapid transit and night shuttle service. Robotaxi public operations are listed in cities including Guangzhou, Abu Dhabi, Zurich, Dubai and Singapore. The driverless stack runs on a computing platform rated at 2,000 TOPS.

The company was established in 2017 and has run an autonomous vehicle fleet for more than 2,500 days. It is listed on Nasdaq and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. It states that its products hold autonomous driving permits in eight markets, among them China, the United Arab Emirates, Singapore and France. Named partners include global carmakers, ride-hailing firms and Tier 1 suppliers.
